svg.title: Same denoising access, different committing context

svg.ns0:title: Initial Tokyo crossing in a warm street palette, schematic
svg.ns0:desc: Original flat vector illustration of an initial wide Tokyo crossing with warm sandstone and brown buildings: the woman faces the camera in a black jacket, red dress and sunglasses. The warm street palette distinguishes initial history content from the cool storefront of recent history. Represents initial history content, not an experimental video frame or accessed KV.

svg.ns0:title: Recent Tokyo storefront in a cool blue palette, schematic
svg.ns0:desc: Original flat vector illustration of the same woman and clothing in a later walking pose beside a cool cyan and blue storefront on a Tokyo side street. The cool building and sign palette distinguishes recent history content from the warm initial crossing. Represents recent history content, not an experimental video frame or accessed KV.
